description: Enjoy this elegant 115 sqm apartment, ideally located in the heart of Paris's 2nd arrondissement on Rue Saint-Marc, and discover the best of the City of Light!With three bedrooms and three bathrooms, it can comfortably accommodate up to 8 people.Its major asset is its lovely terrace, rare and highly sought-after in Paris, perfect for enjoying a moment of relaxation in the open air.The spaceNestled in the quiet rue Saint-Marc, in the exquisite Bourse/Opera area, this breathtaking 115sqm apartment with A/C invites you to stay in the heart of Paris.On the 6th floor, with elevator, of a beautiful building, you will appreciate the view of the Parisian skyline. This incredible 3 bedroom opens onto an open and fully equipped kitchen; which leads to the living room equiped with a cozy dining area that can accommodate up to 8 people, as well as a Queen-Size sofa bed.All the bedrooms are equipped with King-Size beds, smart TVs and large storage spaces. Two of them have their adjoining bathroom with a nice walk-in shower and toilet.The third bathroom is independent, as well as the toilets. One of the major asset of this exceptional apartment is that it's fully air-conditioned.At the cutting edge of technology, this apartment benefits from connected televisions and high-speed wifi.For maximum comfort, this apartment has hotel quality bedding, linens and towels, a washer-dryer and a Nespresso coffee machine.
